us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall along the US Gulf Coast
bullets: Isaias came ashore as a dangerous Category 2 hurricane.
Officials urged first responders to focus on storm response.
The system weakened after hitting the Florida coast.

articles.title: Trump says he struck diesel deal with Putin
bullets: Trump announced a deal to obtain diesel from Russia.
The move reverses years of US pressure over Ukraine.
Democrats and Ukraine criticized the decision sharply.

articles.title: Opposition grows to Pentagon execution livestream plan
bullets: Republican lawmakers joined religious leaders opposing the plan.
Senator Mark Warner condemned livestreamed executions as barbaric.
Trump was still weighing the proposal Friday.

articles.title: Five people shot dead at Georgia residence, police say
bullets: Police reported five deaths at a home in Douglas, Georgia.
Officers responded to the residence on October 9.
Authorities released limited details as the investigation continued.

articles.title: Trump and Iran both deny election timing is driving war decisions
bullets: Trump and Iranian leaders denied midterms are shaping war decisions.
Inflation and gas prices have fueled public disapproval.
The conflict remains a major campaign issue before November voting.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Russian attack on Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia kills seven
bullets: Zaporizhzhia’s regional governor reported seven deaths Saturday.
The strike hit the southern Ukrainian city in the morning.
Russia’s attacks continued despite diplomacy around Ukraine.

articles.title: Taiwan president says island will not give up freedom
bullets: Taiwan’s president said peace remains a priority.
He said Taiwan’s people must have their rights respected.
The remarks followed renewed Chinese maritime pressure.

articles.title: Germany’s firewall against far-right AfD faces pressure
bullets: Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned extremism is entering parliament.
Germany’s long-standing isolation of AfD is under strain.
The debate has intensified inside German politics.

articles.title: French policing scrutinized after student protest injuries
bullets: A 14-year-old student suffered severe facial injuries.
French police tactics at student protests face renewed scrutiny.
The issue has raised public concern over crowd-control methods.

articles.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens off Mexico’s Pacific coast
bullets: Simon rapidly intensified near Mexico’s Pacific coast.
Sustained winds reached about 110 mph.
Tourist regions were warned about worsening conditions.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India detains youth protest leader ahead of Delhi rally
bullets: Police detained Abhijit Dipke before a planned protest.
The Cockroach movement demanded the election chief resign.
Authorities deployed thousands of security personnel in Delhi.

articles.title: Delhi locked down before Jantar Mantar protest
bullets: Authorities turned parts of Delhi into a security fortress.
Metro restrictions, market closures and travel curbs were imposed.
The protest targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

articles.title: Internet shutdown ordered before Delhi protest
bullets: Mobile internet was suspended in parts of the capital.
Platforms received takedown advisories over public-order concerns.
The measures preceded the Jantar Mantar demonstration.

articles.title: Train cancellations strand passengers in Jammu and Katra
bullets: Passengers were stranded after train cancellations.
The Jammu railway division said special arrangements were made.
The disruption coincided with wider security measures.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi says democracy repair begins after CEC and Modi government go
bullets: Rahul Gandhi attacked the election chief and Modi government.
He linked the issue to broader democratic repair.
Opposition parties intensified criticism over voter-list revisions.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: US market movers and trading themes

articles.title: Wall Street ends higher and posts weekly gains
bullets: All three major US indexes advanced Friday.
Investors looked ahead to earnings and inflation data.
AI-related momentum stocks were generally higher.

articles.title: Humana jumps after Medicare Advantage ratings data
bullets: Humana shares rose 11.6% in Friday trading.
Government data showed strong 2027 plan ratings.
The move made Humana a standout market gainer.

articles.title: Apple falls after reported iPhone component production cuts
bullets: Apple shares declined after a production-cut report.
The report involved iPhone 18 Pro components.
The move weighed on major tech sentiment.

articles.title: Delta slides after cutting annual profit forecast
bullets: Delta Air Lines shares fell Friday.
The carrier cut its annual profit forecast.
The downgrade pressured airline-sector sentiment.

articles.title: Telecom stocks drop after SpaceX spectrum acquisition
bullets: SpaceX acquired a low-band spectrum portfolio.
Telecom shares traded lower after the announcement.
The deal became a notable Friday market-moving event.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories in focus

articles.title: SpaceX spectrum deal pressures telecom companies
bullets: SpaceX bought a low-band spectrum portfolio.
The transaction pressured listed telecom names.
Investors assessed competitive implications for wireless services.

articles.title: Delta lowers annual profit outlook
bullets: Delta reduced its full-year profit forecast.
Shares slid following the airline’s update.
The cut drew attention before earnings season.

articles.title: AI infrastructure borrowing concerns hang over markets
bullets: Investors watched large technology fundraising plans.
Higher yields made capital more expensive and selective.
Balance sheets and future earnings quality moved into focus.

articles.title: Earnings season set to begin with major US banks
bullets: Investors shifted focus to third-quarter earnings season.
Large US banks are expected to report first.
Inflation data may shape expectations for Fed policy.

articles.title: Thailand prepares to host IMF–World Bank meetings
bullets: Bangkok will host the annual meetings October 12–18.
More than 15,000 participants are expected.
The event will gather global finance officials and institutions.

articles.title: AI founders cheer Trump’s hands-off safety approach
bullets: San Francisco’s Tech Week highlighted industry enthusiasm.
Trump urged AI companies to police themselves on safety.
The White House favors voluntary controls over regulation.

articles.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers amid risk dispute
bullets: OpenAI said the employees breached trust.
The researchers accused the company of prioritizing corporate interests.
The firings followed wider debate over AI safety culture.

articles.title: Poll finds most Americans think AI is developing too fast
bullets: AP-NORC found broad concern across party lines.
Respondents prioritized keeping AI under human control.
Worker protection also ranked as a major public concern.

articles.title: Norway considers temporary ban on AI smart glasses in some public places
bullets: Privacy concerns put smart glasses under scrutiny.
Meta’s Ray-Ban AI glasses are part of the debate.
Retailers are awaiting outcomes before final decisions.

articles.title: AI insiders warn New York City Council about safety risks
bullets: Former and current AI workers testified in Manhattan.
They urged stronger oversight from local governments.
Representatives from major AI firms also defended safety efforts.
